I, myself, although a Five Point Calvinist, am not a Protestant, but a classical Baptist.

The Doctrines of Grace are best remembered by the acronym T.U.L.I.P. Each letter corresponds to one of the five Doctrines of Grace:

T = Total depravity

U = Unconditional Election

L = Limited Atonement

I = Irresistible Grace

P = Preservation (or Perseverance) of the saints.

Whlist Arminianism teaches that man has some role in his own salvation, the Doctrines of Grace teach the Scriptural position that man is dead in trespasses and sins. Dead men can do nothing.
